'''Roberto Markarian Abrahamian''' (12 December 1946) is a Uruguayan mathematician of [[Armenian Uruguayans|Armenian]] descent, expert in [[dynamical system]]s and [[chaos theory]].

== Biography ==
He started studying at the University of the Republic in the 1960s. During the civic-military dictatorship he was arrested due to political reasons. Later he went to Brazil, where he graduated from the [[Federal University of Rio Grande do Sul]]. Later on, his degree was validated in Uruguay.

Markarian served as [[Rector (academia)|rector]] of the [[University of the Republic]] (2014-2018).<ref>{{cite web |url=https://udelar.edu.uy/portal/institucional/rectores-anteriores/ |title=University of the Republic: last rectors |website=[[Universidad de la República]] |language=es |access-date=13 October 2022}}</ref>

He is brother of the football coach [[Sergio Markarián]].
